name: be dead forever simulator
desc:
MODERN GAMING. Presently lacking the complete understanding of the art form known as VIDEO GAMES; not to reflect upon the world's ecologically and economically crumbling state, perchance. Yet through the hustles of chaos in the world, we hear them loud and clear. Gamers across the globe have ascended beyond human intelligence and being, some would even consider them omnipotent, perchance. MODERN VIDEO GAMES. not at all conducive to the collective vision of what we call "Gamers", to which we acknowledge their plead in these dastardly times. In return, we have formed an art piece from their collective mindset forged from Sisyphean decades of spilt blood and tears. Your efforts to human evolution have not gone to waste, Gamers, for we present to you: BE DEAD FOREVER SIMULATOR.

"Be Dead Forever Simulator isn't just a game, it's an experience, a memorable experience that I will be telling my grand children about. 9/10" - IGN

"i did not say that bruh" - not IGN
